about_short_description.short_description: YonedaLabs is an AI-based software that assists chemists in optimizing reaction parameters such as temperature, concentration, and catalyst.

product.name: Yoneda Predict
product.description: An AI model trained on experimental data to predict reliable reaction conditions for novel chemical reactions, accelerating lead compound nomination and analog synthesis.

product.name: Yoneda Optimize
product.description: A software tool that uses machine learning and statistical methods to optimize chemical reaction parameters, reducing experimental workload and improving process conditions.

product.name: Yoneda Analyze
product.description: An automated LCMS data analysis tool that detects, integrates, and visualizes chromatographic peaks, including overlapping ones, to save manual labor.
